comments.author: DBravo
comments.body: This version of Cowboy Boots with Livestock & Sniping boosts is sometimes available as one of the weekly exchange items available from the Gold Nugget Appraiser at San Francisco for 12000 appraised nuggets value.

wiki: Sold for 12,000 points from Large Gold Nugget Exchange shop in San Francisco. Shop contents change weekly on Mondays, so this item is not always available.
